type_rule: Registered query-side form: pronoun it/this/these/that/those or fewer than 8 whitespace words => context_or_rewrite; otherwise explicit. Official N is assigned only after response for scoring; it is not an online input.
retrieval_scope: Native returned bounded candidates before parent expansion; Recall@5 and MRR over that list. Original and Agentic retain their configured candidate limits.
token_scope: Agentic observed completed-response Ollama usage; original generation usage was not captured. Original token total remains unknown; raw embedding-only usage is retained in the raw records. No local monetary price is invented.
